lines_of_business: UnitedHealthcare Individual Exchange (Community Plan and Medicare Advantage have separate policies)
effective_or_revised: Effective October 1, 2026; policy number printed 2026T0525VV (file name says UU); 31 pages
sections_in_order: Coverage Rationale (Diagnosis; Nonsurgical Treatment; Surgical Treatment; Other Surgical Procedures; Central Sleep Apnea)
Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale pp.1-3 (surgical treatment on p.2); Definitions pp.3-4 supply AHI/RDI, severity and the polysomnography requirement. Clinical Evidence (pp.7-24) is evidence.
procedures_covered: Implantable HGNS adult and Down syndrome adolescent
Unproven: lingual suspension, isolated hyoid myotomy, stand-alone uvulectomy, TORS, distraction osteogenesis, phrenic nerve stimulation for CSA, many nonsurgical devices

logic.top_level: pathways: separate all-of lists for (UPPP/mandibular osteotomy/MMA), (adult HGNS), (adolescent Down syndrome HGNS); 'In addition' criteria per procedure for MMA and mandibular osteotomy
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Unproven and not medically necessary' lists; one negative criterion inside HGNS (absence of complete concentric collapse; absence of tracheostomy). No patient contraindication list.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No revision or replacement criteria. Footnote: polysomnography should be repeated if clinically significant weight change, CVD change, or persistent/recurrent symptoms since the last study.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: PAP therapy resulted in no therapeutic efficacy or individual's refusal or intolerance
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three alternatives in one bullet; 'refusal' alone suffices (like Cigna's 'unwillingness', looser than a numeric adherence test).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Total AHI of < 25% for central and mixed Apneas
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Garbled: AHI is not a percentage; means central+mixed < 25% of total events.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: an AHI ≥ 10 and Respiratory Disturbance Index ≤ 50 events per hour
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Down syndrome row mixes AHI for lower bound and RDI for upper bound; also says 'severe OSA' while AHI >= 10 only; 'severe' (> 30) is defined elsewhere.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In addition, the following criteria need to be met: For MMA ...; For mandibular osteotomy ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Conditional criteria: apply only to the named procedure; UPPP has no extra item.

extraction_hazards: Bullet glyphs missing in text (criteria lines appear with no marker so 'all the following' items cannot be told from continuation lines)
Asterisk footnote carries a criterion (repeat PSG) at the bottom of the criteria block
Criteria continue across a page break (Other Surgical Procedures starts on p.2 and continues p.3)
Policy number in header differs from file name (VV vs UU)
Definitions on pages 3-4 supply thresholds and test types
Square brackets inside criterion [AHI >=15 or RDI >=15]
Clinical Evidence is 17 pages with thresholds from studies
interesting_structures: Surgical block treats UPPP, mandibular osteotomy and MMA as a group with extra per-procedure conditions
Attended polysomnography is required (HSAT not accepted for surgical criteria) via footnote
Delegates oral appliance criteria to InterQual
Epworth Sleepiness Scale required for surgery but not HGNS
Caregiver/individual refusal of MMA is a criterion for Down syndrome HGNS

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Short all-of lists with numeric leaves and one conditional-per-procedure add-on. The garbled AHI/RDI wording and footnote are the main hazards; oral appliance criteria are external (InterQual).
